content: Pest 4.7.5 (current, July 2026) requires PHP ^8.3.0, phpunit ^12.5.30 -- incompatible with the project's locked PHP 8.2 floor. Pest 3.8.7 (last 3.x release) requires PHP 8.2.0+ and is the only line usable on PHP 8.2 CI jobs. Mutation testing (--mutate) was introduced in Pest 3, so both majors support it. Recommend dual composer constraint pestphp/pest: ^3.8|^4.0 so Composer resolves 3.x on PHP 8.2 jobs and 4.x on PHP 8.3+ jobs.
